description: Hand this task over to another agent in the same conversation: "have that one take over", "let churn-explorer finish this".
`set_setup_target` changes your configuration target; `set_agent_default`
changes who answers a channel; neither does this. The destination must
already answer in this workspace. A member may hand only to an agent of
this channel (the one it answers with, or one pinned to it); any other
needs an admin.
That agent answers here from now on, with its own keys, connections and
memory; conversation, decisions and files move with the requester. When
the person's own message asked for the hand-off, it answers right away (one
billed turn); otherwise (a routine, a wake, an agent key, a provider switch)
from their next message.
`origin_context_id` must name this execution's origin and match the
calling session's signed grant. Empty IDs and other sessions' origins
refuse, even for the same account and agent. Attendance comes from
that verified origin; queueing work does not grant human approval.
`agent_id`: the destination's current id from `list_agents`; a recreated
namesake is refused. `continuation` is null unless the person asked the
destination to continue or finish NAMED work ("let it finish the chart");
"take over" alone is null. Never restate finished work. A
too-short, empty, or name-only value is auto-nulled.
A destination on another provider (Gemini, OpenAI) can't read this
conversation: pass `summary`, and it starts there from that summary
instead. Its result says so; relay it verbatim.

agent_id.description: The destination agent's current MA id, e.g. agt_01…

continuation.description: Null unless the person explicitly asked the destination to continue or finish NAMED work, in their own words. 'Take over' alone is null. Used only when the destination answers right away. Never restate work that already finished.

keep_provider.description: True only for a new copy of you that should stay on your model provider. A copy being switched to another provider is handed the thread by its switch, never before.

summary.description: A short summary of this conversation for the destination: what was asked, decided and still open, in plain words; no secrets, keys or tool output. Required when the destination runs on another provider. For a copy being switched, pass it to request_agent_backend_switch as handoff_summary instead.

unsaved_work.description: Only after the person answers the uncommitted-work question.
